name: Slider
purpose: Lets users select a value (single) or a range (double) by sliding a handle along a predefined numerical track. Optional tick markers and value labels.

props.name: type
props.$note: Single = one handle/value; double = two handles for a range.

props.name: value
props.$note: Track fill position (single shows default/half/full; double shows default/half).

variants.name: single
variants.use: One handle selecting a single value along the track.

variants.name: double
variants.use: Two handles selecting a min/max range.

tokens.track-filled: scrollbar/foreground (#767676) — REUSE of the scrollbar token for the filled portion
tokens.handle: background/default (#fff fill) + border/subtle (#d7d8d6 border); hover tertiary/background/hover (#f3f3f3), pressed tertiary/background/pressed (#767676)

commonPatterns: slider with tick markers + value labels

accessibility.role: Use role=slider (single) / two thumbs for range, each with aria-valuemin/max/now and an accessible name
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys adjust value (Home/End to min/max); range thumbs must not cross without feedback
accessibility.valueText: Expose aria-valuetext for non-numeric / formatted values; visible value label should reflect current value
accessibility.useOfColour: Filled vs unfilled track must be distinguishable beyond colour (the handle position conveys value)
accessibility.targetArea: Handle hit target min 44px even if the visual thumb is smaller

antiPatterns: No keyboard operation (arrow keys) for value adjustment
REVIEW (inferred): using a slider where precise numeric entry is required (pair with an input)
Leaving the tick marker on the deprecated neutral-6 border token (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — handle + single/double tracks CLEAN; only the tick marker carries 1 deprecated token.
tokenValidation.tokenReuse: The slider TRACK reuses scrollbar/foreground (filled) + scrollbar/background (unfilled) rather than a dedicated slider/track token — worth noting for a future semantic 'slider/*' group.

tokens.rebind: REVIEW — form/border/default | scrollbar/foreground (both #767676); replacement-map lists neutral-6 as review (mode-aware on dark)

depricateUsage.note: Handle (background/default + border/subtle + tertiary/background hover/pressed) and tracks (scrollbar/*) are fully live. Only the 1px tick marker still binds the deprecated neutral-6 border. Same neutral-6 token also used by On-Dark Divider (section) — a mode-aware divider/border rebind may suit both.
